local Players         = game:GetService("Players")
local player          = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui       = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DISCORD_URL   = "https://discord.gg/zQbQJH5rMb"
local GATE_SECONDS  = 15
local LOADER_URL    = "https://klze-hub.pages.dev/loader"

local uc = {
	Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
	Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),
	Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
	Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
	Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
	On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
}

local function make(className, props, parent)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
	inst.Parent = parent
	return inst
end

local function corner(parent, radius)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
end

local function copyDiscord()
	pcall(function()
		if setclipboard then
			setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
		elseif toclipboard then
			toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
		end
	end)
end

-- =========================================================
-- SPLASH — Discord gate, 15s countdown, then onDone()
-- =========================================================
local function showSplash(onDone)
	local splash = make("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "HackingBrosSplash",
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		DisplayOrder = 200,
	}, playerGui)

	make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,

	}, splash)

	local card = make("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 300),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),

	make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 76),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Copy the invite link and hop in for the full release. The script below auto-loads once the timer runs out.",
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
	}, card)

	local linkBox = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 38),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 148),
		BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Text = "discord.gg/zQbQJH5rMb",
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = uc.Text,
	}, card)
	corner(linkBox, 8)
	make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, linkBox)

	local copyBtn = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 198),
		BackgroundColor3 = uc.Discord,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Text = "Copy Discord Invite",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = uc.Text,

	corner(copyBtn, 8)

	copyBtn.Activated:Connect(function()

		copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end)

	local countdown = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20),

		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = uc.Muted,

	local start = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(GATE_SECONDS - (os.clock() - start)))

	make("TextLabel", {

	btn.Activated:Connect(function()

		task.delay(1.4, function()
			if label.Parent then
				label.Text = "Join DC for more awsum scripts for free"

-- =========================================================
-- FIRE LOADER
-- =========================================================
local function runLoader()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet(LOADER_URL))()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[HackingBros] loader failed: " .. tostring(err))

scripts.code:
-- HRP PREDICTIVE LOCK-ON (RAW + SHIFTLOCK)
-- StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Roblox Studio LocalScript
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Settings = {
	Prediction = 0.22,
	MaxPrediction = 0.65,
	SearchRadius = 120,
	RequireLineOfSight = true,
	UsePrediction = true, -- set to false for pure raw HRP aim
}

local State = {
	Mode = "Idle",
	Selected = nil,
	Target = nil,
	Connection = nil,
}

-- SHIFTLOCK CONTROL
local function shiftLockOn()
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
end

local function shiftLockOff()
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
end

-- GUI
local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "HRPLockOn"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.Parent = PlayerGui

local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
Button.Name = "LockButton"
Button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
Button.Position = UDim2.new(0.82, 0, 0.65, 0)
Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
Button.Text = "🔓"
Button.TextSize = 25
Button.Parent = Gui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
Corner.Parent = Button

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Thickness = 2
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 110)
Stroke.Parent = Button

local Status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Status.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 28)
Status.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -95, 0, -34)
Status.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
Status.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Status.TextSize = 11
Status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Status.Visible = false
Status.Parent = Button

local StatusCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
StatusCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
StatusCorner.Parent = Status

-- DRAGGING
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition
local dragInput

Button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = Button.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

Button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and input == dragInput then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		Button.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

-- CHARACTER HELPERS
local function getCharacter(player)
	if not player then return end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not hrp or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	return character, humanoid, hrp
end

-- TARGET VISIBILITY
local function canSee(character, part)
	if not Settings.RequireLineOfSight then
		return true
	end
	local myCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return false end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		myCharacter,
		camera
	}
	local direction = part.Position - camera.CFrame.Position
	local result = workspace:Raycast(
		camera.CFrame.Position,
		direction,
		params
	)
	return result ~= nil
		and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

-- TARGET SELECTION
local function findTarget()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return nil end
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local center = Vector2.new(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2
	)
	local bestTarget
	local bestDistance = Settings.SearchRadius
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer then
			local character, humanoid, hrp = getCharacter(player)
			if character and hrp then
				local screen, visible =
					camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
				if visible and screen.Z > 0 then
					local distance = (
						Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center
					).Magnitude
					if distance < bestDistance
						and canSee(character, hrp) then
						bestDistance = distance
						bestTarget = player
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestTarget
end

-- PREDICTION
local StopThreshold = 0.5 -- studs/sec; below this the target counts as stopped

local function predictPosition(hrp)
	local velocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speed = velocity.Magnitude
	-- Target fully stopped: no prediction, raw HRP aim.
	if speed < StopThreshold then
		return hrp.Position
	end
	local predictionTime = math.clamp(
		Settings.Prediction + speed / 150,
		0,
		Settings.MaxPrediction
	)
	return hrp.Position + velocity * predictionTime
end

-- UNLOCK
local function unlock()
	if State.Connection then
		State.Connection:Disconnect()
		State.Connection = nil
	end
	State.Target = nil
	State.Selected = nil
	State.Mode = "Idle"
	shiftLockOff()
	Button.Text = "🔓"
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
	Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 110)
	Status.Visible = false
end

-- LOCK
local function lock(player)
	local character, humanoid, hrp = getCharacter(player)
	if not character then
		unlock()
		return
	end
	local myCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
	local myHumanoid = myCharacter
		and myCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local myHRP = myCharacter
		and myCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not myHumanoid or not myHRP then
		unlock()
		return
	end

	State.Target = player
	State.Mode = "Locked"
	shiftLockOn()
	Button.Text = "🔒"
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 115, 55)
	Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 255, 110)
	Status.Text = "HRP LOCKED: " .. player.DisplayName
	Status.Visible = true

	State.Connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local targetCharacter, targetHumanoid, targetHRP =
			getCharacter(State.Target)
		local currentCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
		local currentHRP = currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local currentHumanoid = currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not targetCharacter
			or not currentHRP
			or not currentHumanoid then
			unlock()
			return
		end

		-- Keep shiftlock held every frame (Roblox resets it on camera changes).
		shiftLockOn()

		-- Aim point: predicted position, or the raw HRP itself.
		local aimPosition = targetHRP.Position
		if Settings.UsePrediction then
			aimPosition = predictPosition(targetHRP)
		end

		-- RAW lock-on: face the aim point instantly, no smoothing/lerp.
		local origin = currentHRP.Position
		local flatTarget = Vector3.new(
			aimPosition.X,
			origin.Y,
			aimPosition.Z
		)
		local difference = flatTarget - origin
		if difference.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			currentHRP.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
				origin,
				flatTarget
			)
		end
	end)
end

-- BUTTON
Button.Activated:Connect(function()
	if State.Mode == "Idle" then
		local target = findTarget()
		if target then
			State.Selected = target
			State.Mode = "Selected"
			Button.Text = "✅"
			Button.BackgroundColor3 =
				Color3.fromRGB(20, 130, 65)
			Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 255, 110)
			Status.Text = "SAVE TARGET: " .. target.DisplayName
			Status.Visible = true
		else
			Status.Text = "NO TARGET FOUND"
			Status.Visible = true
			task.delay(1.5, function()
				if State.Mode == "Idle" then
					Status.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end
	elseif State.Mode == "Selected" then
		if State.Selected and getCharacter(State.Selected) then
			lock(State.Selected)
		else
			unlock()
		end
	elseif State.Mode == "Locked" then
		unlock()
	end
end)

-- TARGET LEAVING
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if player == State.Target or player == State.Selected then
		unlock()
	end
end)

-- RESPAWN
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	unlock()
end)

-- Function to attach boots, larger backpack, wires, sound, and hide feet/shoes
local function attachRocketBoots(char)
    local bootsModel = Instance.new("Model")
    bootsModel.Name = "RocketBootsModel"
    bootsModel.Parent = char
    
    local leftFoot = char:FindFirstChild("Left Foot") or char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
    local rightFoot = char:FindFirstChild("Right Foot") or char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
    local upperTorso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not leftFoot or not rightFoot or not upperTorso then return end
    
    -- Thoroughly hide feet, shoes, and foot accessories safely
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            local name = obj.Name
            if name == "Left Foot" or name == "Right Foot" or 
               name == "LeftLowerLeg" or name == "RightLowerLeg" or
               name == "Left Leg" or name == "Right Leg" or
               name == "LeftHeel" or name == "RightHeel" or
               string.find(string.lower(name), "shoe") or 
               string.find(string.lower(name), "boot") or
               string.find(string.lower(name), "foot") then
                obj.Transparency = 1
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Model") then
            local name = string.lower(obj.Name)
            if string.find(name, "shoe") or string.find(name, "boot") or string.find(name, "foot") then
                for _, p in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Transparency = 1 end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Even Bigger Backpack Box on the back
    local backBox = Instance.new("Part")
    backBox.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 2.0, 1.2)
    backBox.Color = currentBackpackColor
    backBox.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    backBox.CanCollide = false
    backBox.Massless = true
    
    local boxWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    boxWeld.Part0 = upperTorso
    boxWeld.Part1 = backBox
    boxWeld.Parent = backBox
    
    backBox.CFrame = upperTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.8)
    backBox.Parent = bootsModel
    
    -- Function to configure touch/collision filtering: touches walls/ground/objects ONLY, ignores players
    local function setupCollisionFilter(part)
        part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
            local hitChar = hit.Parent
            local hitPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitChar)
            if hitPlayer then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end)
    end
    
    -- Wire with correct fixed orientation (Restored!)
    local function createWire(fromPart, toPart, isLeftSide)
        local wire = Instance.new("Part")
        wire.Name = "Wire"
        wire.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 1)
        wire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 0, 0)
        wire.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wire.CanCollide = false
        wire.Massless = true
        wire.Parent = bootsModel
        
        local xOffset = isLeftSide and -0.9 or 0.9
        local yawAngle = isLeftSide and math.rad(-15) or math.rad(15)
        
        local connection
        connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not wire or not wire.Parent or not fromPart or not toPart then
                if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
                return
            end
            local p1 = (fromPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(xOffset, -0.8, 0.2)).Position
            local p2 = toPart.Position
            local distance = (p1 - p2).Magnitude
            if distance > 0.1 then
                wire.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, distance)
                wire.CFrame = CFrame.new(p1, p2) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180), yawAngle, 0)
            end
        end)
    end
    
    local function createRocket(targetPart, isLeftSide)
        local bootBlock = Instance.new("Part")
        bootBlock.Size = Vector3.new(1.0, 1.2, 1.0)
        bootBlock.Color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 0, 0)

        bootBlock.Massless = true
        
        local weld1 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld1.Part0 = targetPart
        weld1.Part1 = bootBlock
        weld1.Parent = bootBlock
        
        bootBlock.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0)
        bootBlock.Parent = bootsModel
        
        local conePart = Instance.new("Part")
        conePart.Name = "BootNozzle1"
        conePart.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.6, 0.5)
        conePart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        conePart.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        conePart.CanCollide = true
        conePart.Massless = true
        setupCollisionFilter(conePart)
        
        local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://1033714"
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, 0.5)
        mesh.Parent = conePart
        
        local weld2 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld2.Part0 = bootBlock
        weld2.Part1 = conePart
        weld2.Parent = conePart
        
        conePart.CFrame = bootBlock.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.2, -0.85, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
        conePart.Parent = bootsModel

        local conePart2 = Instance.new("Part")
        conePart2.Name = "BootNozzle2"
        conePart2.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.6, 0.5)
        conePart2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        conePart2.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        conePart2.CanCollide = true
        conePart2.Massless = true
        setupCollisionFilter(conePart2)
        
        local mesh2 = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

        mesh2.MeshId = "rbxassetid://1033714"
        mesh2.Scale = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.7, 0.5)

        local weld3 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")

        conePart2.CFrame = bootBlock.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.2, -0.85, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)

        local bFire1 = Instance.new("Fire")
        bFire1.Name = "RocketTriangleFire"

        bFire1.Size = 3

        bFire2.Heat = -12
        bFire2.Parent = conePart2
        
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "RocketSound"
        sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://4809574295"
        sound.Volume = 2
        sound.Looped = false
        sound.Parent = conePart
        
        createWire(backBox, bootBlock, isLeftSide)
    end
    
    createRocket(leftFoot, true)

end

        if not isOutOfFuel then movingDown = true end 
    end)
    downBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() movingDown = false end)
    downBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() movingDown = false end)
    
    centerBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if isOutOfFuel then return end
        isLocked = not isLocked
        if isLocked then
            centerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                lockedCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            end
        else
            centerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
            lockedCFrame = nil
        end
    end)
    
    controlConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if rootPart and humanoid then
                
                local activeFireAndSound = (not isOutOfFuel) and (isLocked or movingUp or movingDown)
                
                if activeFireAndSound then
                    drainTimer = drainTimer + dt
                    if movingUp then
                        if drainTimer >= 0.500 then
                            drainTimer = 0
                            fuel = math.max(0, fuel - 1.0)
                        end
                    elseif movingDown then
                        if drainTimer >= 1.200 then
                            drainTimer = 0
                            fuel = math.max(0, fuel - 0.5)
                        end
                    elseif isLocked then
                        if drainTimer >= 1.500 then
                            drainTimer = 0
                            fuel = math.max(0, fuel - 1.0)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    drainTimer = 0
                end
                
                if fuel <= 0 then
                    if not isOutOfFuel then

                        movingUp = false
                        movingDown = false
                        isLocked = false
                        lockedCFrame = nil
                        centerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

                    end
                    percentLabel.Text = "No fuel!"
                    fuelFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                else
                    percentLabel.Text = math.floor(fuel + 0.5) .. "%"
                    fuelFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, fuel / 100, 0)
                    
                    if fuel > 50 then
                        fuelFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 40)
                    elseif fuel > 20 then
                        fuelFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 200, 40)
                    else
                        fuelFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40)
                    end
                end
                
                fireTimer = fireTimer + dt
                soundTimer = soundTimer + dt
                
                local fireInterval = 0.001
                local soundInterval = 0.001
                
                if movingUp then
                    fireInterval = 0.001
                    soundInterval = 0.001
                elseif movingDown then
                    fireInterval = 0.020
                    soundInterval = 0.010
                elseif isLocked then
                    fireInterval = 0.010
                    soundInterval = 0.005
                end
                
                local triggerFire = activeFireAndSound and (fireTimer >= fireInterval)
                if triggerFire then fireTimer = 0 end
                
                local triggerSound = activeFireAndSound and (soundTimer >= soundInterval)
                if triggerSound then soundTimer = 0 end
                
                for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if desc.Name == "RocketTriangleFire" and desc:IsA("Fire") then
                        if activeFireAndSound then
                            desc.Enabled = true
                            if movingUp then
                                desc.Size = 6
                                desc.Heat = -25
                            elseif movingDown then
                                desc.Size = 4
                                desc.Heat = -12
                            else
                                desc.Size = 4
                                desc.Heat = -15
                            end
                        else
                            desc.Enabled = false
                        end
                    elseif desc.Name == "RocketSound" and desc:IsA("Sound") then
                        if activeFireAndSound and triggerSound then
                            desc:Play()
                        elseif not activeFireAndSound and desc.IsPlaying then
                            desc:Stop()
                        end
                    end
                end

                if isLocked and not isOutOfFuel then
                    rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    if lockedCFrame then
                        rootPart.CFrame = lockedCFrame
                    end
                else
                    lockedCFrame = nil
                    
                    local headOrientation = head and head.CFrame.UpVector or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                    local lookVec = head and head.CFrame.LookVector or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                    local flatLookVec = Vector3.new(lookVec.X, 0, lookVec.Z).Unit
                    
                    local targetY = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
                    if movingUp and not isOutOfFuel then
                        targetY = headOrientation.Y * 35
                    elseif movingDown and not isOutOfFuel then
                        targetY = -30
                    end
                    
                    local targetX, targetZ = 0, 0
                    local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
                    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 and not isOutOfFuel then
                        targetX = flatLookVec.X * 25
                        targetZ = flatLookVec.Z * 25
                    end
                    
                    rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(targetX, targetY, targetZ)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function setupToolEvents(t)
    t.Equipped:Connect(function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if humanoid and rootPart then
            activeEffectsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            activeEffectsFolder.Name = "RocketBootsFolder"
            activeEffectsFolder.Parent = char
            
            attachRocketBoots(char)
            createControlGUI()
            
            infJumpConnection = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                if humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                    return
                end
                
                if not isOutOfFuel and char and humanoid and rootPart then
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 60, rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    t.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if infJumpConnection then
            infJumpConnection:Disconnect()
            infJumpConnection = nil
        end
        if controlConnection then
            controlConnection:Disconnect()
            controlConnection = nil
        end
        if screenGui then
            screenGui:Destroy()
            screenGui = nil
        end
        if warningGui then
            warningGui:Destroy()
            warningGui = nil
        end
        if activeEffectsFolder then
            activeEffectsFolder:Destroy()
            activeEffectsFolder = nil
        end
        
        if isOutOfFuel then
            fuel = 100
            isOutOfFuel = false
            currentBackpackColor = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
        end
        
        local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if playerGui then
            local touchGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
            if touchGui then
                local touchControlFrame = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
                if touchControlFrame then
                    local jumpButton = touchControlFrame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
                    if jumpButton then
                        jumpButton.Visible = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local name = obj.Name
                    if name == "Left Foot" or name == "Right Foot" or 
                       name == "LeftLowerLeg" or name == "RightLowerLeg" or
                       name == "Left Leg" or name == "Right Leg" or
                       name == "LeftHeel" or name == "RightHeel" or
                       string.find(string.lower(name), "shoe") or 
                       string.find(string.lower(name), "boot") or
                       string.find(string.lower(name), "foot") then
                        obj.Transparency = 0
                    end
                elseif obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Model") then
                    local name = string.lower(obj.Name)
                    if string.find(name, "shoe") or string.find(name, "boot") or string.find(name, "foot") then
                        for _, p in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                            if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Transparency = 0 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj.Name == "RocketBootsModel" then
                    obj:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

if Tool then
    setupToolEvents(Tool)
end

-- Handle character respawn safely
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    local humanoid = newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            if isOutOfFuel then
                fuel = 100
                isOutOfFuel = false
                currentBackpackColor = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
            end
        end)
    end
    task.wait(1.5)
    Tool = giveTool()
    if Tool then
        setupToolEvents(Tool)
    end
end)

local isResizing = false
local resizeStartPos = nil
local startScale = 1

resizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isResizing = true
		resizeStartPos = input.Position
		startScale = currentScale
	end
end)

local function makeDraggable(frame)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil

	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not isResizing then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			if isResizing then
				dragging = false
				return
			end
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

makeDraggable(timerFrame)
makeDraggable(settingsFrame)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if isResizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - resizeStartPos
		local scaleChange = delta.X / BASE_WIDTH
		setScale(startScale + scaleChange)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isResizing = false
	end
end)

local function formatTime(seconds)
	local mins = math.floor(seconds / 60)
	local secs = math.floor(seconds % 60)
	local ms = math.floor((seconds * 100) % 100)
	return string.format('%02d:%02d.<font size="36">%02d</font>', mins, secs, ms)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if isRunning then
		elapsedTime += deltaTime
		timerLabel.Text = formatTime(elapsedTime)
	end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

openSettingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	waitingForBind = nil
end)

toggleBindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	waitingForBind = "Toggle"
	toggleBindBtn.Text = "..."
	resetBindBtn.Text = resetKey.Name
end)

resetBindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	waitingForBind = "Reset"
	resetBindBtn.Text = "..."
	toggleBindBtn.Text = toggleKey.Name
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		if waitingForBind == "Toggle" then
			toggleKey = input.KeyCode
			toggleBindBtn.Text = toggleKey.Name
			waitingForBind = nil
			return
		elseif waitingForBind == "Reset" then
			resetKey = input.KeyCode
			resetBindBtn.Text = resetKey.Name
			waitingForBind = nil
			return
		end
		
		if input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
			isRunning = not isRunning
		elseif input.KeyCode == resetKey then
			isRunning = false
			elapsedTime = 0
			timerLabel.Text = formatTime(0)
		end
	end
end)

local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or request
local function downloadAsset(url)
    local clean = url:match("^([^?]+)") or url
    clean = clean:gsub("/revision/latest$", "")
    local name = clean:match("([^/]+)$") or "file"
    local dir  = clean:match("^https?://(.+)/[^/]+$") or "misc"
    local host = clean:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
    if not name:match("%.%w+$") then name = name .. ".png" end
    local path = "cache/" .. dir .. "/" .. name
    if isfile(path) then
        local ok, a = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
        if ok then return a end
    end
    warn("[Assets] Downloading", name)
    local res = req and req({Url = clean, Method = "GET", Headers = { 
        ["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0", 
        ["Referer"] = "https://" .. host .. "/",
    }})
    local data = res and res.Body
    if not data or #data == 0 or data:sub(1,1) == "<" then
        warn("[Assets] fail:", url, res and res.StatusCode)
        return nil
    end
    local acc = ""
    for p in dir:gmatch("[^/]+") do
        acc = acc == "" and ("cache/" .. p) or (acc .. "/" .. p)
        if not isfolder(acc) then makefolder(acc) end
    end
    writefile(path, data)
    print("[Assets]  Downloaded", name)
    return getcustomasset(path)
end
local function myAsset(fileName)
    local cachePath = "cache/lil2kki.7m.pl/rosy/" .. fileName
    if isfile(cachePath) then return getcustomasset(cachePath) end
    warn(hi, "Downloading " .. fileName, "into", cachePath)
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet("http://lil2kki.7m.pl/rosy/assets/" .. fileName) 
    end)
    if success and result then
        writefile(cachePath, result)
        print(hi, "+Downloaded " .. fileName, "into", cachePath)
        return getcustomasset(cachePath)
    else
        warn(hi, "failed to load " .. fileName)
        return nil
    end
end

local function new(class, props)
	local obj = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		if k ~= "Parent" then
			obj[k] = v
		end
	end
	obj.Parent = props.Parent
	return obj
end

local function tween(obj, time, props, style, dir)
	local t = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

	local s = new("Sound", {
		SoundId = id,

		PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1,
		Parent = SoundService,
	})
	s:Play()
	if cutAfter then

	Debris:AddItem(s, 3)
	return s

	local p = settings.intensity

local function getChar()
	local c = player.Character
	if not c then return end
	local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local h = c:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local hu = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if r and h and hu and hu.Health > 0 then
		return c, r, h, hu
	end
end

	label(row, str, 14, WHITE, Enum.Font.Gotham, {Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 22), ZIndex = 23})

	local track = new("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 23, Parent = row})
	corner(track, 4)

	corner(fill, 4)
	local function show()
		local a = (settings[key] - minV) / (maxV - minV)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(a, 0, 1), 1)
		val.Text = string.format(fmt, settings[key])
	end
	show()
	local dragging = false
	local function fromInput(input)
		local a = math.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		settings[key] = minV + (maxV - minV) * a
		show()
		onSettingChanged(key)
	end
	track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			fromInput(i)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			fromInput(i)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

local function lightingOn()
	if lightingBackup then return end
	lightingBackup = {
		Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
		OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
		Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
		FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
		FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
		FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
	}
	cc = new("ColorCorrectionEffect", {Name = "EE_ColorCorrection", Parent = Lighting})
	bloom = new("BloomEffect", {Name = "EE_Bloom", Intensity = 0.4, Size = 24, Threshold = 1.1, Parent = Lighting})
	blur = new("BlurEffect", {Name = "EE_Blur", Size = 0, Parent = Lighting})
	applyLighting()
end

applyLighting = function()
	if not lightingBackup then return end
	local b = lightingBackup
	if settings.darkness then
		tween(Lighting, 1.2, {
			Ambient = theme.ambient,
			OutdoorAmbient = theme.ambient,
			Brightness = math.max(b.Brightness * 0.45, 0.3),
			FogColor = theme.ambient,
			FogStart = 15,
			FogEnd = 260,
		})
	else
		tween(Lighting, 1.2, {
			Ambient = b.Ambient,
			OutdoorAmbient = b.OutdoorAmbient,
			Brightness = b.Brightness,
			FogColor = b.FogColor,
			FogStart = b.FogStart,
			FogEnd = b.FogEnd,
		})
	end
	if cc then
		tween(cc, 1, {TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(theme.light, 0.18)})
	end
end

local function lightingOff()
	if not lightingBackup then return end
	local b = lightingBackup
	lightingBackup = nil
	tween(Lighting, 1, {
		Ambient = b.Ambient,
		OutdoorAmbient = b.OutdoorAmbient,
		Brightness = b.Brightness,
		FogColor = b.FogColor,
		FogStart = b.FogStart,
		FogEnd = b.FogEnd,
	})
	local c, bl, bu = cc, bloom, blur
	cc, bloom, blur = nil, nil, nil
	task.delay(1.1, function()
		if c then c:Destroy() end
		if bl then bl:Destroy() end
		if bu then bu:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function punchBlur(size)
	if blur and not settings.reducedMotion then
		blur.Size = size
		tween(blur, 0.5, {Size = 0})
	end
end

	e.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
	e.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.5)
	e.Transparency = fade(0.2)
	e.LockedToPart = false
	for k, v in pairs(cfg) do
		if typeof(v) == "number" then
			if rangeKeys[k] then
				v = NumberRange.new(v)
			elseif k == "Size" or k == "Transparency" then
				v = NumberSequence.new(v)
			end
		elseif typeof(v) == "Color3" then
			v = ColorSequence.new(v)
		end
		pcall(function() e[k] = v end)
	end
	local base = cfg.Rate or 20
	e.Rate = base * power()
	e.Parent = parent
	emitters[e] = base
	return e
end

applyPower = function()
	for e, base in pairs(emitters) do
		if e.Parent then e.Rate = base * power() end
	end
end

-- glowing trail ribbons that orbit the player (no solid parts visible)
local function ribbon(cfg)
	local trails = {}
	local count = cfg.count or 2
	local width = cfg.width or 0.5
	for i = 1, count do
		local p = ghost(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3))
		local a0 = new("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, width / 2, 0), Parent = p})
		local a1 = new("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, -width / 2, 0), Parent = p})
		local tr = new("Trail", {
			Attachment0 = a0,
			Attachment1 = a1,
			Lifetime = cfg.life or 0.7,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Color = cfg.color or ColorSequence.new(theme.main, theme.dark),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 0.1), kp(1, 1)}),
			WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 1), kp(1, 0)}),
			MinLength = 0.02,
			FaceCamera = true,
			Parent = p,
		})
		table.insert(trails, tr)
		local phase = (i - 1) / count * math.pi * 2
		local speed = cfg.speed or 3
		local radius = cfg.radius or 3
		local height = cfg.height or 0
		addUpdater(function(dt, t, root, beat)
			local ang = t * speed + phase
			local r = radius * (1 + beat * 0.15) + (cfg.jitter and (math.random() - 0.5) * cfg.jitter or 0)
			local h = height + math.sin(t * (cfg.bob or 2) + phase) * (cfg.bobAmp or 0)
			local v = Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * r, h, math.sin(ang) * r)
			if cfg.tilt then v = CFrame.Angles(cfg.tilt, 0, 0) * v end
			p.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + v)
		end)
	end
	return trails
end

-- glowing summoning circle on the ground with rotating arcs
local function groundRing(diameter)
	local function disc(color, material, transp)
		return new("Part", {
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.1, diameter, diameter),
			Anchored = true,
			CanCollide = false,
			CanQuery = false,
			CanTouch = false,
			Material = material,
			Color = color,
			Transparency = transp,
			Parent = auraFolder,
		})
	end
	local outer = disc(theme.main, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.55)
	local inner = disc(theme.dark, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0.4)
	addUpdater(function(dt, t, r, beat)
		local d = diameter * (1 + beat * 0.12)
		local cf = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, r.Position.Y - groundOffset + 0.08, r.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		outer.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, d, d)
		outer.CFrame = cf
		inner.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, d * 0.86, d * 0.86)
		inner.CFrame = cf + Vector3.new(0, 0.03, 0)
	end)
	ribbon({count = 3, radius = diameter * 0.43, height = -groundOffset + 0.25, speed = 2.5, width = 0.25, life = 1.2})
end

local function shockwave(pos, color, diameter, life, startTransp)
	local d = new("Part", {
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 2, 2),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = false,
		CanQuery = false,
		CanTouch = false,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		Color = color,
		Transparency = startTransp or 0.5,
		CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		Parent = fxFolder,
	})
	tween(d, life or 0.6, {Size = Vector3.new(0.2, diameter, diameter), Transparency = 1})
	Debris:AddItem(d, (life or 0.6) + 0.1)
end

-- jagged lightning bolt between two points (beams on terrain attachments)
local function bolt(a, b, color, width, segs)
	local pts = {a}
	for i = 1, segs - 1 do
		local base = a:Lerp(b, i / segs)
		local j = 2.2
		pts[#pts + 1] = base + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * j * 2, (math.random() - 0.5) * j, (math.random() - 0.5) * j * 2)
	end
	pts[#pts + 1] = b
	local atts = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(pts) do
		local at = new("Attachment", {Parent = workspace.Terrain})
		at.WorldPosition = p
		atts[i] = at
		Debris:AddItem(at, 0.45)
	end
	for i = 1, #atts - 1 do
		for layer = 1, 2 do
			local w = layer == 1 and width or width * 0.35
			local bm = new("Beam", {
				Attachment0 = atts[i],
				Attachment1 = atts[i + 1],
				Color = ColorSequence.new(layer == 1 and color or WHITE),
				LightEmission = 1,
				Width0 = w,
				Width1 = w,
				FaceCamera = true,
				Segments = 1,
				Parent = workspace.Terrain,
			})
			tween(bm, 0.3, {Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0})
			Debris:AddItem(bm, 0.45)
		end
	end
end

local function rayParams()
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {curChar, auraFolder, fxFolder}
	return rp
end

local function flatLook()
	local l = camera.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	if l.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		l = curRoot.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	end
	return l.Unit
end

			table.insert(colorables, tr)
		end
	end
	addUpdater(function(dt, t)
		for i, o in ipairs(colorables) do
			if o.Parent then
				o.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.2 + i * 0.09) % 1, 0.85, 1), Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.2 + i * 0.09 + 0.2) % 1, 0.85, 1))
			end
		end
		if auraHighlight then
			auraHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.2) % 1, 0.85, 1)
			auraHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.2 + 0.3) % 1, 0.7, 1)
		end
	end)
end

buildAura = function()
	auraFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	auraUpdaters = {}
	table.clear(emitters)
	auraHighlight = nil
	if not curRoot then return end

	-- shared base: pulsing light + soft outline glow
	local lightPart = follower(Vector3.zero)
	local pl = new("PointLight", {Color = theme.main, Range = 18, Brightness = 2, Shadows = false, Parent = lightPart})
	local hl = new("Highlight", {
		Adornee = curChar,
		FillColor = theme.main,
		FillTransparency = 0.88,
		OutlineColor = theme.light,
		OutlineTransparency = 0.35,
		DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded,
		Parent = auraFolder,
	})
	auraHighlight = hl
	addUpdater(function(dt, t, r, beat)
		pl.Brightness = (1.5 + beat * 3) * power()
		pl.Range = 14 + beat * 10
		if selectedTheme ~= "GLITCH" and selectedTheme ~= "PRISM" then
			hl.FillTransparency = 0.9 - beat * 0.2
		end
	end)
	if selectedTheme ~= "GLITCH" and selectedTheme ~= "PRISM" then
		pl.Color = theme.main
	end
	builders[selectedTheme]()
end

	local startP = ghost(nil, fxFolder)
	local endP = ghost(nil, fxFolder)
	local a0 = new("Attachment", {Parent = startP})
	local a1 = new("Attachment", {Parent = endP})

		return new("Beam", {Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = 1, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(transp), Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0, FaceCamera = true, Segments = 1, Parent = startP})
	end
	local outer = beam(theme.main, 0.25)

	local impact = emit(endP, {Rate = 90, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7), Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Size = grow(0.5, 0.35, 0), Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, theme.main)})
	new("PointLight", {Color = theme.main, Range = 22, Brightness = 4, Parent = endP})

		local w = (1.4 + math.sin(el * 50) * 0.2) * g
		outer.Width0, outer.Width1 = w, w

local function refreshSpeed()
	if not active or not curHum then return end

	local show = active and settings.abilityBar
	tween(abilityBar, 0.4, {Position = show and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 120)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)

onSettingChanged = function(key)
	if key == "eyes" then
		if active then buildEyes() end
	elseif key == "darkness" then
		applyLighting()
	elseif key == "abilityBar" then
		refreshBar()
	elseif key == "speedBoost" then
		refreshSpeed()
	elseif key == "volume" then
		if music then music.Volume = settings.volume * 0.7 end
	elseif key == "intensity" then
		applyPower()
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- main render loop (runs only while the aura is on)
----------------------------------------------------------------
local function onRender(dt)
	if not active or not curRoot or not curRoot.Parent then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local t = now - activeSince
	local p = power()
	local frozen = now < freezeUntil

	-- beat detection
	local loud = (music and music.IsPlaying) and music.PlaybackLoudness or 0
	loudAvg = loudAvg + (loud - loudAvg) * math.min(1, dt * 1.5)
	local hit, strength = false, 0.6
	if loud > 20 and loud > loudAvg * (1 + BEAT_THRESHOLD) and now - lastBeat > 0.2 then
		hit = true
		strength = math.clamp((loud / math.max(loudAvg, 1) - 1) / 0.5, 0.35, 1)
	elseif loud < 3 and t > 2.5 and now - lastBeat > 0.5 then
		hit = true -- music didn't load, fake a pulse so effects still move
	end
	if hit then
		lastBeat = now
		beatEnergy = math.max(beatEnergy, strength)
		if not overdrive then rage = math.min(1, rage + RAGE_PER_BEAT) end
		if settings.shockwave then
			shockwave(groundPos(), theme.main, 14 + strength * 14, 0.7, 0.6)
		end
		if settings.screenFx and not settings.reducedMotion then
			flash.BackgroundColor3 = theme.main
			flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.94
			tween(flash, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end
	beatEnergy = beatEnergy * (1 - math.min(1, dt * 5))

	-- overdrive meter
	if overdrive then
		if now >= overdriveEnd then
			overdrive = false
			rage = 0
			applyPower()
		end
	elseif rage >= 1 then
		overdrive = true
		overdriveEnd = now + OVERDRIVE_TIME
		applyPower()
		banner("OVERDRIVE", theme.main)
		ripple(theme.main)
		screenFlash(theme.main, 0.7, 0.5)
		shakeAmount = math.max(shakeAmount, 1.5)
	end
	local fillTarget = overdrive and math.max(0, (overdriveEnd - now) / OVERDRIVE_TIME) or rage
	rageFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fillTarget, 1)

	-- auto cycle
	if settings.autoCycle and now - lastCycle > 18 then
		lastCycle = now
		cycleTheme(1)
	end

	-- camera (fov bop + shake)
	local bopAmt = settings.bop and (settings.reducedMotion and 1.5 or 5) or 0
	local goal = fovGoal + (frozen and -9 or 0)
	fovPunch = fovPunch + (goal - fovPunch) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
	camera.FieldOfView = baseFov + beatEnergy * bopAmt * p + fovPunch + tauntPunch * 4
	if settings.shake and not settings.reducedMotion then
		local amt = (beatEnergy * 0.09 + shakeAmount + tauntPunch * 0.1) * p
		if amt > 0.002 then
			camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame
				* CFrame.new((math.random() - 0.5) * amt, (math.random() - 0.5) * amt, 0)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * amt * 0.02)
		end
	end
	shakeAmount = shakeAmount * (1 - math.min(1, dt * 6))

	-- screen effects
	if settings.screenFx then
		local v = math.clamp((0.35 + beatEnergy * 0.45) * p * 0.8, 0, 1)
		vignette.GroupTransparency = 1 - v
	else
		vignette.GroupTransparency = 1
	end
	if cc then
		cc.Saturation = cc.Saturation + ((frozen and -1 or theme.sat) - cc.Saturation) * math.min(1, dt * 4)
		cc.Contrast = frozen and 0.4 or 0.08
		cc.Brightness = beatEnergy * 0.04
	end
	if bloom and now > 0 then
		bloom.Intensity = bloom.Intensity + ((0.35 + beatEnergy * 0.9) - bloom.Intensity) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
	end
	if music then
		local target = frozen and 0.5 or 1
		music.PlaybackSpeed = music.PlaybackSpeed + (target - music.PlaybackSpeed) * math.min(1, dt * 4)
	end

	-- eyes
	if eyes and eyes.gui.Parent then
		local s = 1 + beatEnergy * 0.55 * p + tauntPunch * 0.5
		eyes.l.Rotation = (t * 110) % 360
		eyes.r.Rotation = (-t * 110) % 360
		eyes.l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4 * s, 0.8 * s)
		eyes.r.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4 * s, 0.8 * s)
	end

	-- theme specific stuff
	for i = 1, #auraUpdaters do
		pcall(auraUpdaters[i], dt, t, curRoot, beatEnergy)
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- start / stop
----------------------------------------------------------------
startAura = function()
	local char, root, head, hum = getChar()
	if not char then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		lightingOff()
		return
	end
	curChar, curRoot, curHead, curHum = char, root, head, hum
	groundOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and 3 or (hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2)
	savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
	active = true
	activeSince = os.clock()
	lastCycle = activeSince
	beatEnergy, loudAvg, lastBeat, shakeAmount, fovPunch, fovGoal = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	rage, overdrive, freezeUntil = 0, false, 0
	cooldownUntil = {}

	lightingOn()
	buildAura()
	buildEyes()
	refreshSpeed()
	refreshBar()
	tween(hud, 0.5, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 14)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	tween(mainWrap, 0.3, {BackgroundColor3 = theme.main})
	tween(blur, 0.5, {Size = 0})

	music = new("Sound", {Name = "EE_Music", SoundId = MUSIC_ID, Looped = true, Volume = 0, Parent = SoundService})
	music:Play()
	tween(music, 2, {Volume = settings.volume * 0.7})

	deathConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
		stopAura()
	end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("EnemyEncounterRender", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, onRender)
end

stopAura = function()
	if not active then return end
	active = false
	session += 1
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("EnemyEncounterRender")
	if deathConn then
		deathConn:Disconnect()
		deathConn = nil
	end
	if curHum and curHum.Parent then
		curHum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
	end
	auraFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	fxFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	auraUpdaters = {}
	table.clear(emitters)
	auraHighlight = nil
	if eyes then
		eyes.gui:Destroy()
		eyes = nil
	end
	if music then
		local m = music
		music = nil
		tween(m, 1, {Volume = 0})
		Debris:AddItem(m, 1.2)
	end
	lightingOff()
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	tween(camera, 0.6, {FieldOfView = baseFov})
	tween(vignette, 0.6, {GroupTransparency = 1})
	tween(hud, 0.4, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -70)})
	tween(mainWrap, 0.3, {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE})
	rageFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	refreshBar()
	curChar, curRoot, curHead, curHum = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- typing / cutscene / taunt
----------------------------------------------------------------
local function typeLine(str, my)
	textLabel.Text = ""
	for i = 1, #str do
		if session ~= my then return false end
		textLabel.Text = string.sub(str, 1, i)
		local ch = string.sub(str, i, i)
		if ch ~= " " and settings.typeSounds then
			playSound(TYPE_SOUND_ID, settings.volume * 0.5, 0.9 + math.random() * 0.25, 0.15)
		end
		tauntPunch = math.max(tauntPunch, taunting and 0.6 or 0)
		task.wait(skipRequested and 0.005 or 0.045)
	end
	return true
end

local function pause(sec, my)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < sec do
		if session ~= my or skipRequested then return end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

runEncounter = function()
	if busy or active or taunting then return end
	local char, root, head, hum = getChar()
	if not char then return end
	busy = true
	skipRequested = false
	session += 1
	local my = session
	local prevSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
	baseFov = camera.FieldOfView
	hum.WalkSpeed = 0
	lightingOn()
	tween(vignette, 1, {GroupTransparency = 0.35})
	tween(blur, 1.5, {Size = 8})
	letterbox(true)

	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local facePos = head.Position + head.CFrame.LookVector * 4.5 + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
	local camTween = tween(camera, 2, {CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(facePos, head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)), FieldOfView = 38}, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)

	pause(1.7, my)
	local ok = session == my
	if ok then
		barIn(RED, true)
		local lines = {"Hello, I'm one of the enemies you fought.", "...", "I think you should run instead of facing me."}
		for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
			if not typeLine(line, my) then ok = false break end
			pause(i == 2 and 1.1 or 1.4, my)
			if session ~= my then ok = false break end
		end
	end
	barOut()
	letterbox(false)
	camTween:Cancel()
	if hum and hum.Parent then hum.WalkSpeed = prevSpeed end

	if not ok then
		busy = false
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		camera.FieldOfView = baseFov
		if not active then
			lightingOff()
			tween(vignette, 0.5, {GroupTransparency = 1})
		end
		return
	end

	-- whiteout, reset camera under the flash, then start the aura
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	task.wait(0.1)
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	camera.FieldOfView = baseFov
	busy = false
	startAura()
	tween(flash, 1, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	banner("THEY FOUND YOU", theme.main)
end

taunt = function()
	if taunting or busy then return end
	taunting = true
	local my = session
	barIn(WHITE, false)
	local ok = typeLine("I think i remember you.", my)
	if ok then pause(1.3, my) end
	if ok and session == my then
		ok = typeLine("No, I'm just imagining things.", my)
		if ok then pause(1.5, my) end
	end
	barOut()
	taunting = false
end

scripts.author: bilmeyenkisi
scripts.summary: - ESP with a GUI - Harder to detect because it doesnt use Highlight, it instead draws a box around the players. - Able to customize the ESP colors from the menu - Has Red, Green, Blue, Yellow and White - I don't take any credit in this,…
scripts.code:
-- CONFIG
local DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- State
local espEnabled = false
local hudVisible = true
local espObjects = {}
local playerColors = {}
local dragging = false
local dragInput = nil
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

-- ScreenGui HUD
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ESPGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Main HUD Frame
local hudFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
hudFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 300)
hudFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -150)
hudFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
hudFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
hudFrame.Parent = screenGui

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
uiCorner.Parent = hudFrame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Text = "ESP  [L=Toggle] [O=Hide]"
title.Parent = hudFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
titleCorner.Parent = title

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 38)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
statusLabel.TextScaled = true
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLabel.Text = "Status: OFF"
statusLabel.Parent = hudFrame

local scrollFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -75)
scrollFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 70)
scrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scrollFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
scrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4
scrollFrame.Parent = hudFrame

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
listLayout.Parent = scrollFrame

local colorOptions = {
    { name = "Red",    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)  },
    { name = "Green",  color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)  },
    { name = "Blue",   color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 150, 255) },
    { name = "Yellow", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 50) },
    { name = "White",  color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)},
}

-- ============================================
--              DRAGGING
-- ============================================

local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    hudFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale,
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPos.Y.Scale,
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = hudFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

-- ============================================
--              ESP LOGIC
-- ============================================

local function applyBox(player)
    if player == localPlayer then return end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    if espObjects[player] and espObjects[player].box then
        espObjects[player].box:Destroy()
    end
    if espObjects[player] and espObjects[player].boxLoop then
        espObjects[player].boxLoop:Disconnect()
    end

    local color = playerColors[player] or DEFAULT_COLOR

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Adornee = hrp
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 90)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    billboard.Parent = hrp

    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.BorderSizePixel = 0
    container.Parent = billboard

    local thickness = 2

    local top = Instance.new("Frame")
    top.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thickness)
    top.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    top.BackgroundColor3 = color
    top.BorderSizePixel = 0
    top.Parent = container

    local bottom = Instance.new("Frame")
    bottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thickness)
    bottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -thickness)
    bottom.BackgroundColor3 = color
    bottom.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bottom.Parent = container

    local left = Instance.new("Frame")
    left.Size = UDim2.new(0, thickness, 1, 0)
    left.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    left.BackgroundColor3 = color
    left.BorderSizePixel = 0
    left.Parent = container

    local right = Instance.new("Frame")
    right.Size = UDim2.new(0, thickness, 1, 0)
    right.Position = UDim2.new(1, -thickness, 0, 0)
    right.BackgroundColor3 = color
    right.BorderSizePixel = 0
    right.Parent = container

    if espObjects[player] then
        espObjects[player].box = billboard
    else
        espObjects[player] = { box = billboard }
    end

    local loop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not espEnabled then return end
        if not billboard or not billboard.Parent then return end
        local localChar = localPlayer.Character
        if not localChar then return end
        local localHRP = localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not localHRP then return end
        if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end

        local distance = (hrp.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
        local _, onScreen = camera:WorldToScreenPoint(hrp.Position)
        if not onScreen then return end

        local fov = math.rad(camera.FieldOfView)
        local screenHeight = camera.ViewportSize.Y
        local pixelsPerStud = screenHeight / (2 * distance * math.tan(fov / 2))

        local pixelW = 4.0 * pixelsPerStud
        local pixelH = 6.0 * pixelsPerStud

        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, pixelW, 0, pixelH)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end)

    espObjects[player].boxLoop = loop
end

local function applyBillboard(player)
    if player == localPlayer then return end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end

    if espObjects[player] and espObjects[player].billboard then
        espObjects[player].billboard:Destroy()
    end

    local color = playerColors[player] or DEFAULT_COLOR

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.Parent = head

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = color
    nameLabel.TextScaled = true
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.Text = player.Name
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard

    if espObjects[player] then
        espObjects[player].billboard = billboard
    else
        espObjects[player] = { billboard = billboard }
    end

    applyBox(player)
end

local function removeESP(player)
    if espObjects[player] then
        if espObjects[player].billboard then
            espObjects[player].billboard:Destroy()
        end
        if espObjects[player].box then
            espObjects[player].box:Destroy()
        end
        if espObjects[player].boxLoop then
            espObjects[player].boxLoop:Disconnect()
        end
        espObjects[player] = nil
    end
end

-- ============================================
--              HUD PLAYER LIST
-- ============================================

local function buildPlayerList()
    for _, child in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #players * 70)

    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        if player == localPlayer then continue end

        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Parent = scrollFrame

        local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        rowCorner.Parent = row

        local pName = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        pName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
        pName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4)
        pName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        pName.TextColor3 = playerColors[player] or DEFAULT_COLOR
        pName.TextScaled = true
        pName.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        pName.Text = player.Name
        pName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        pName.Parent = row

        local colorRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        colorRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
        colorRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 30)
        colorRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        colorRow.Parent = row

        local colorListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        colorListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        colorListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        colorListLayout.Parent = colorRow

        for _, option in ipairs(colorOptions) do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 1, 0)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = option.color
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.Text = ""
            btn.Parent = colorRow

            local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            btnCorner.Parent = btn

            local tip = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            tip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
            tip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 2)
            tip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            tip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
            tip.TextScaled = true
            tip.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            tip.Text = option.name
            tip.Parent = btn

            local capturedPlayer = player
            local capturedColor = option.color

            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playerColors[capturedPlayer] = capturedColor
                pName.TextColor3 = capturedColor
                if espEnabled and espObjects[capturedPlayer] then
                    applyBillboard(capturedPlayer)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================
--         TOGGLE / DESTROY / HIDE
-- ============================================

local function toggleESP()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled
    if espEnabled then
        statusLabel.Text = "Status: ON"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= localPlayer then
                applyBillboard(player)
            end
        end
    else
        statusLabel.Text = "Status: OFF"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            removeESP(player)
        end
    end
end

local function toggleHUD()
    hudVisible = not hudVisible
    hudFrame.Visible = hudVisible
end

local function destroyESP()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        removeESP(player)
    end
    screenGui:Destroy()
end

-- ============================================
--         KEYBINDS — CHAT AWARE
-- ============================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, _gameProcessed)
    if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        toggleESP()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.O then
        toggleHUD()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Minus then
        destroyESP()
    end
end)

-- ============================================
--              PLAYER EVENTS
-- ============================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    buildPlayerList()
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if espEnabled then
            task.wait(0.5)
            applyBillboard(player)
        end
    end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removeESP(player)
    playerColors[player] = nil
    buildPlayerList()
end)

-- Init
buildPlayerList()

local function UpdateScrollingFrame()
    local totalHeight = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then
            totalHeight = totalHeight + child.Size.Y.Offset + 5
        end
    end
    G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"].CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalHeight)
    
    local yOffset = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then
            child.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, yOffset)
            yOffset = yOffset + child.Size.Y.Offset + 5
        end
    end
    
    G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"].CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, totalHeight)
end


local function CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
        contents = {{ parts = {{ text = userMessage }} }}
    })
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return request({
            Url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=" .. Api_Gemini67,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end
    
    if not response or not response.Body then
        return "Error: No response from server"
    end
    
    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format - " .. tostring(data)
    end
    
    if data and data.candidates and data.candidates[1] and 
       data.candidates[1].content and data.candidates[1].content.parts and
       data.candidates[1].content.parts[1] and data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text then
        local aiText = data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text
        return aiText
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "API Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse AI response. Check console for details."
end

local function CallAI(userMessage)
    if currentAI == "Gemini" then
        return CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Claude" then
        return CallClaudeAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ClaudeApi)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Llama" then
        return CallGroqLlamaAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Gpt Oss" then
        return CallGroqGptOssAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Gpt-4" then
        return CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ChatGptApi)
    else
        return "Please select an AI model from the settings"
    end
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end


local function ShowLoadingMessage()
    local loadingLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    loadingLabel.Name = "LoadingMessage"
    loadingLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
    loadingLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    loadingLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    loadingLabel.FontFace = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/Inconsolata.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    loadingLabel.TextSize = 14
    loadingLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    loadingLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": ..."
    loadingLabel.Parent = G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]
    
    UpdateScrollingFrame()
    
    local dots = 0
    local animationRunning = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while animationRunning and loadingLabel.Parent do
            dots = (dots % 3) + 1
            loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": " .. string.rep(".", dots)
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
    
    return loadingLabel, function()
        animationRunning = false
    end
end

scripts.summary: It does the obby as quick as it can.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo

    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end
